issues.where: the red fronded plants, foreground and left
issues.what: fronds are thin, dry, dark wiry strands with only faint red rim light; -a has thick, wet, glossy crimson fronds strung with water beads and dripping drops, strongly backlit to glowing red-orange
issues.fix: thicken the fronds, make them wet and translucent with bead droplets and falling drips, and let the low sun backlight them to a saturated crimson glow

issues.what: pale grey pitted sinter crust with no stones; -a has wet, dark rock with rounded pebbles, a pale bone and runoff water glinting in the light
issues.fix: replace with wet dark rock and pebbles, add the bone and wet sheen catching the sun

issues.where: the creature in the haze, upper left
issues.what: the long-necked animal is tiny, faint and pushed to the far plain; in -a it is a clear, large white silhouette standing in the sun-glare at mid-distance
issues.fix: bring the animal closer and larger, a crisp backlit white figure against the glare

issues.what: a sharp snow-streaked mountain wall is visible; in -a the distance dissolves in warm steam and haze with only soft pale terraces
issues.fix: remove the snow, push the far landforms back into warm steam so visibility drops

issues.where: the rock ledges and chasm, right
issues.what: smooth bright cream rounded boulders, evenly lit; -a has darker layered ledges with a dripping overhang above a deep steaming chasm
issues.fix: darken and layer the ledges, add the dripping overhang and denser steam rising from the gorge

issues.what: cooler, greyer, flatter grade with the sun disc washed out; -a is a warm golden low sun with strong rim light and specular glints everywhere
issues.fix: warm the grade toward gold, lift contrast and add specular glints on wet surfaces

issues.where: the arched ribs of the sinkhole wall
issues.what: ribs read as flat, dry, mottled stone slabs; in -a they are smooth wet bone-like arches, cream with rust streaks, glistening and dripping
issues.fix: reshape into smooth curved rib arches, give them a wet sheen, rust-orange staining and water dripping off their edges

issues.what: only a sliver of dry dark fronds at the frame edge; in -a a large wet crimson plant fills the left with droplets falling into the pit
issues.fix: bring in the full wet crimson plant with hanging drops on the left

issues.where: the far plain and horizon, top
issues.what: the far shallows, grazing animals, small red plants on the rim and the hazy golden sun glare are almost all cropped out or missing
issues.fix: open the top to show the glinting shallows with distant animals and red tufts along the rim in warm haze

issues.where: the pit walls between the ribs
issues.what: crisp horizontally banded strata with streaky low-res texture; -a has dark wet mossy walls with vertical seep streaks and green tint
issues.fix: wet the walls, add green moss tones and vertical water seeps, soften the strata banding

issues.what: a heavy, dense grey wall of steam covers almost half the frame; in -a the vapour rises in softer, thinner wisps lit warm by the sun
issues.fix: thin the steam and let it catch warm sidelight so the pit depth reads through it

issues.what: a pale speckled boulder intrudes; -a has wet rock with moss and droplets in the bottom-left foreground
issues.fix: replace with wet, mossy foreground rock catching sun glints

issues.what: flat, cool, low-contrast light without golden rim highlights; -a has a warm low sun raking across wet surfaces
issues.fix: warm the light and add strong specular highlights on the wet bone and rock
